audio.t: Hello, this is a message for Mr. Tom Hughes from the Parkview Medical Center. You have an appointment with Dr. Lin tomorrow at ten thirty. Unfortunately, Dr. Lin has been called to an emergency at the hospital and will not be available. We can offer you the same time on Thursday with Dr. Lin, or tomorrow at eleven with Dr. Morales. Please call us back at 555-0172 to let us know which you prefer. If we don't hear from you by five today, we'll keep you with Dr. Lin on Thursday.

questions.prompt: Why is the speaker calling?
questions.evidence: Dr. Lin has been called to an emergency at the hospital and will not be available
questions.explanation: Le médecin n'est pas disponible : le rendez-vous doit être modifié.
questions.takeaway: Be called to an emergency = être appelé en urgence.

questions.prompt: What options are offered to the listener?
options: A different day or a different doctor
questions.evidence: the same time on Thursday with Dr. Lin, or tomorrow at eleven with Dr. Morales
questions.explanation: Il peut voir Dr Lin jeudi ou Dr Morales demain à 11 h.

questions.prompt: What will happen if the listener does not call back by five?
options: He will see Dr. Lin on Thursday.
He will see Dr. Morales tomorrow.
He will be charged a fee.
questions.evidence: we'll keep you with Dr. Lin on Thursday
questions.explanation: Sans réponse avant 17 h, le rendez-vous est maintenu avec Dr Lin jeudi.
questions.takeaway: « If we don't hear from you » = option par défaut.

audio.t: Good afternoon, shoppers. Westfield Plaza is pleased to welcome the opening of Nova Electronics on the second floor, next to the food court. To celebrate, Nova is offering fifteen percent off all headphones and speakers this weekend. The first fifty customers each day will also receive a free phone charger. And a reminder that our parking garage is free for the first two hours with any purchase over twenty euros. Just show your receipt at the information desk.

questions.prompt: What is being announced?
questions.evidence: welcome the opening of Nova Electronics
questions.explanation: Le centre annonce l'ouverture du magasin Nova Electronics.

questions.prompt: What will some customers receive?
questions.evidence: The first fifty customers each day will also receive a free phone charger.
questions.explanation: Les 50 premiers clients chaque jour reçoivent un chargeur gratuit.
questions.takeaway: The first fifty = les cinquante premiers.

questions.prompt: How can shoppers get free parking?
options: By shopping at Nova Electronics only
By spending more than twenty euros
questions.evidence: free for the first two hours with any purchase over twenty euros
questions.explanation: Le parking est gratuit 2 heures pour tout achat de plus de 20 €.

audio.t: Let's start with the new warehouse project. As some of you know, the construction company has informed us that the roof won't be finished until the end of April, about a month later than planned. I want to be clear: this won't affect our customers. Our current warehouse lease has been extended until June, so we'll have plenty of time to move. What I need from each department head is an updated moving plan by next Friday.

questions.prompt: What problem does the speaker mention?
questions.evidence: the roof won't be finished until the end of April, about a month later than planned
questions.explanation: Le toit sera terminé avec un mois de retard.
questions.takeaway: Later than planned = plus tard que prévu.

questions.prompt: Why does the speaker say, "I want to be clear: this won't affect our customers"?
options: To reassure listeners about the consequences
To announce a new customer policy
questions.evidence: I want to be clear: this won't affect our customers.
questions.explanation: Elle rassure : le retard n'aura pas d'impact sur les clients, car le bail actuel a été prolongé.
questions.takeaway: « I want to be clear » introduit souvent un message rassurant ou ferme.

questions.prompt: What are department heads asked to do?
questions.evidence: an updated moving plan by next Friday
questions.explanation: Chaque chef de service doit fournir un plan de déménagement mis à jour.

audio.t: Planning business travel can take hours. At Tripwise Corporate, our agents handle everything, from flights and hotels to train tickets and car rentals, so your employees can focus on their work. Our clients save an average of twelve percent on travel costs thanks to our negotiated rates. And if plans change at the last minute, our support team is available twenty-four hours a day. Book a free consultation today, and we'll analyze your company's travel spending at no charge.

questions.prompt: What kind of business is being advertised?
questions.evidence: Planning business travel can take hours.
questions.explanation: Tripwise Corporate organise les voyages d'affaires : c'est une agence spécialisée.

questions.prompt: According to the speaker, how do clients save money?
questions.evidence: thanks to our negotiated rates
questions.explanation: Les clients économisent grâce aux tarifs négociés.

questions.prompt: What is offered free of charge?
questions.evidence: we'll analyze your company's travel spending at no charge
questions.explanation: La consultation inclut une analyse gratuite des dépenses de voyage.

audio.t: Good morning. Before today's fire drill, a few reminders. When the alarm sounds, leave your belongings and walk calmly to the nearest exit. Do not use the elevators. Please note that the main stairwell is being repainted this week, so the exit next to the elevators is closed. Staff on the east side should use the stairwell at the end of their corridor. Everyone else should use the exit behind the kitchen. We'll meet in the parking lot across the street.

questions.prompt: What is the talk mainly about?
questions.evidence: Before today's fire drill, a few reminders.
questions.explanation: L'oratrice donne les consignes de l'exercice d'évacuation.

questions.prompt: Look at the graphic. Which exit is closed this week?
questions.explanation: La sortie à côté des ascenseurs (vers l'escalier principal en peinture) est fermée : Exit 1.
questions.takeaway: Associe la description orale à la ligne du tableau.

questions.prompt: Where will employees gather after leaving the building?
questions.evidence: We'll meet in the parking lot across the street.
questions.explanation: Le point de rassemblement est le parking en face.

audio.t: In business news, carmaker Vireo Motors announced today that it will build its first European factory in northern Portugal. The plant, which will produce electric vans for delivery companies, is expected to create about two thousand jobs when it opens in three years. Vireo chose the site because of its access to the port of Leixões and a regional training program for technicians. Local officials say the project is the largest private investment in the region in a decade.

questions.prompt: What did Vireo Motors announce?
questions.evidence: it will build its first European factory in northern Portugal
questions.explanation: Vireo construira sa première usine européenne au Portugal.

questions.prompt: What will the factory produce?
questions.evidence: will produce electric vans for delivery companies
questions.explanation: L'usine produira des fourgons électriques pour les sociétés de livraison.

questions.prompt: Why was the location chosen?
options: Its port access and training program
questions.evidence: because of its access to the port of Leixões and a regional training program for technicians
questions.explanation: Le site a été choisi pour l'accès au port et le programme de formation régional.

sets.title: Atelier — prise de parole en public

audio.t: Welcome to this workshop on public speaking. Many of you told me in the registration form that you get nervous before presentations. Well, here's a secret: so do most professional speakers. The difference is that they prepare in a specific way. This morning, we'll practice three techniques to structure a short talk. After the break, each of you will give a two-minute presentation, and the group will give you feedback. Don't worry, it'll be a friendly audience.

questions.prompt: What is the workshop about?
questions.evidence: this workshop on public speaking
questions.explanation: L'atelier porte sur la prise de parole en public.
questions.takeaway: Public speaking = prise de parole en public.

questions.prompt: Why does the speaker say, "so do most professional speakers"?
questions.evidence: so do most professional speakers
questions.explanation: Elle rassure les participants : même les professionnels sont nerveux.
questions.takeaway: So do + sujet = c'est aussi le cas de.

questions.prompt: What will listeners do after the break?
questions.evidence: each of you will give a two-minute presentation
questions.explanation: Chacun fera une présentation de deux minutes.

audio.t: Hi, Ms. Duval, it's Sami from Clarion Commercial Properties. I wanted to let you know that the owner of the office space on Rue Vauban has accepted your offer of two thousand eight hundred euros a month. He has one request, though: he'd like the lease to start on the first of September rather than October, because the current tenant is leaving early. I realize that's sooner than you planned. If that's a problem, he's willing to give you the first month at half price.

questions.prompt: What news does the speaker give?
questions.evidence: has accepted your offer of two thousand eight hundred euros a month
questions.explanation: Le propriétaire a accepté son offre de loyer.
questions.takeaway: Accept an offer = accepter une offre.

questions.prompt: What does the owner request?
questions.evidence: he'd like the lease to start on the first of September rather than October
questions.explanation: Il souhaite que le bail commence en septembre au lieu d'octobre.

questions.prompt: What does the owner offer in return?
options: A discount on one month's rent
questions.evidence: he's willing to give you the first month at half price
questions.explanation: Si la date pose problème, il propose le premier mois à moitié prix.
questions.takeaway: Be willing to = être prêt à.

audio.t: Let's look at last quarter's results. Overall, sales were up, and one region stood out with double-digit growth after we opened two new stores there. On the other hand, one region saw sales decline because of road construction near our largest store, which kept many customers away. That work is now finished, so we expect a recovery. Next, Paul will present our plans for the holiday season.

questions.prompt: Look at the graphic. In which region did the company open new stores?
questions.explanation: La région à croissance « à deux chiffres » est l'Est (+11 %), où deux magasins ont ouvert.

questions.prompt: What caused sales to decline in one region?
questions.evidence: because of road construction near our largest store
questions.explanation: Des travaux routiers près du plus grand magasin ont éloigné les clients.

questions.prompt: What will happen next?
questions.evidence: Paul will present our plans for the holiday season
questions.explanation: Paul va présenter les projets pour la période des fêtes.

audio.t: Welcome to your first day at Corvana Insurance. I'm Alain, from human resources. This morning, you'll complete some paperwork and receive your laptops. After lunch, which will be served in the cafeteria on the ground floor, you'll meet your managers. One important thing: you'll each be paired with a buddy, an experienced colleague who can answer everyday questions during your first three months. Your buddy's name is in the welcome folder in front of you.

questions.prompt: Who are the listeners?
questions.evidence: Welcome to your first day at Corvana Insurance.
questions.explanation: C'est leur premier jour : ce sont de nouveaux employés.

questions.prompt: What will listeners do in the afternoon?
questions.evidence: After lunch, which will be served in the cafeteria on the ground floor, you'll meet your managers.
questions.explanation: L'après-midi, ils rencontreront leurs responsables.
questions.traps: La paperasse et les ordinateurs sont prévus le matin.

questions.prompt: What is the role of a buddy?
questions.evidence: an experienced colleague who can answer everyday questions during your first three months
questions.explanation: Le « buddy » est un collègue expérimenté qui répond aux questions du quotidien.
